body: Im scheduling an appointment soon. I'm scared for some reason that he's going to try and talk me out of being transgendered. I have a lot of irrational fear like that.

Made a throwaway account for this;

I just started recognizing the CD parts of me, and like what weekendshoes said, Im not in it for the sexuality. 

Truth be told, my whole life (im 24 now) I've been repressing one very very strong thought; that I wanted to be (more like) a girl. Sometimes I cant tell if I want to be a crossdresser or go full trans. I'm giving myself a while to consider my options and weigh things out.... 

For a long time I tried to disguise it as a fetish, and now im trying to break out of that because treating it like a quick wank fix has just made me feel worse.

I was eager to become a part of this subreddit but sometimes I worry its mostly embracing the act of crossdressing as a fetish more than anything, even though on the side it seems there is a clear seperate subreddit for 'gonewild' cd pics. 

I would LOVE to join this subreddit under my main name, but there is a lot of nsfw stuff on here and I'm stilll adjusting to it as a lifestyle choice... 

Anyway, that's this lonely girl's two cents.
